title: Cosmic-birefringence isotropic rotation angle beta posterior row
description: One published cosmic-birefringence beta posterior. Each row records the central isotropic-rotation angle beta (degrees), the lower/upper 68% C.L. half-widths as two non-negative fields (so an asymmetric posterior is representable WITHOUT abs()/symmetrisation), the dataset, the EB-cross-correlation extraction method, and per-row provenance (published DOI + arXiv id + open arXiv URL). beta is the parity-odd observable extracted from the EB (and TB) cross-correlation after simultaneously solving for the instrumental polarisation-angle miscalibration.

measurement_id.description: Stable identifier for this beta posterior (e.g. 'eskilt_komatsu_2022_wmap_planck_pr4').

beta_deg.description: Central isotropic cosmic-birefringence rotation angle beta in degrees. MAY be negative in principle (the observable is parity-odd and signed) though all four catalogued measurements are positive (~0.3-0.34 deg).

beta_err_lo_deg.description: Lower 68% C.L. half-width of the beta posterior, in degrees (the '-' side of beta = central (+hi/-lo)). Non-negative magnitude; equals beta_err_hi_deg for a symmetric quote. Stored separately from the upper half-width so an asymmetric posterior is never collapsed via abs().

beta_err_hi_deg.description: Upper 68% C.L. half-width of the beta posterior, in degrees (the '+' side). Non-negative magnitude; equals beta_err_lo_deg for a symmetric quote.

confidence_level.description: Confidence level of the quoted half-widths as a fraction (0.68 for the standard 68% C.L.).

significance_sigma.description: Significance (in sigma) at which the measurement excludes beta = 0, where the authors report it (e.g. 2.4, 3.6). Null where the authors decline to assign a cosmological significance.

excludes_zero_cl_percent.description: Confidence level (as a percentage) at which beta = 0 is excluded, where reported (e.g. 99.2, 99.987). Null where not stated.

dataset.description: Data set analysed, e.g. 'Planck PR3 (2018)', 'Planck PR4 (NPIPE)', 'Planck PR4 LFI+HFI', 'Planck PR4 + WMAP 9yr'.

method.description: Extraction method, e.g. 'EB cross-correlation, simultaneous beta + miscalibration angle'. The parity-odd EB (and TB) cross-correlation extraction that simultaneously solves for the instrumental polarisation-angle miscalibration.

sky_fraction.description: Sky fraction (fsky) used in the analysis where the abstract states it (e.g. 0.93 for the Eskilt 2022 frequency-independent fit); null where not quoted.

precision_flag.description: Per-row precision flag. These rows are 'high' (abstract values verbatim).

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes, e.g. carrying an abstract caveat verbatim.

source_doi.description: Published journal DOI of the measuring paper (e.g. 10.1103/PhysRevD.106.063503).

source_url.description: arXiv abstract URL of the measuring paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/<id>) --- the open, attestable anchor for this row.

source_arxiv.description: arXiv identifier of the measuring paper (e.g. '2205.13962').

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source (publication month).

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.
